ALG-01.definition: 账号与普通选题必须使用策略声明的同一单位向量语义空间；相似度使用单位向量点积，即余弦相似度。 V2 reuses this frozen input and candidate contract; portfolio weights and MMR settings are in document.portfolio.
acceptance_examples: 同方向单位向量相似度为1；维度或模型与策略不一致时任务在执行前被阻断。
V2 uses this same gate or input rule and applies the separately configured portfolio objective.

ALG-02.definition: 普通选题适用城市为空时不限城市，否则账号城市必须精确命中；账号在冻结历史窗口中已明确使用过的普通选题从候选中排除。 V2 reuses this frozen input and candidate contract; portfolio weights and MMR settings are in document.portfolio.
acceptance_examples: 上海限定选题不能进入北京账号候选；历史已出现的普通选题不能再次进入该账号候选。
V2 uses this same gate or input rule and applies the separately configured portfolio objective.

ALG-03.definition: 对通过Hard Gate的候选计算余弦相似度，低于最低阈值的候选移除；其余按相似度降序、topic_id升序稳定排序，最多保留Top-K。 V2 reuses this frozen input and candidate contract; portfolio weights and MMR settings are in document.portfolio.
acceptance_examples: 候选超过100条时仅保留相似度最高的100条；同分时topic_id较小者在前。
V2 uses this same gate or input rule and applies the separately configured portfolio objective.

ALG-04.definition: Fit分数由余弦相似度确定：相似度截断到0至1后乘100；Fit只用于正常匹配，兜底不伪造Fit分数。 V2 reuses this frozen input and candidate contract; portfolio weights and MMR settings are in document.portfolio.
acceptance_examples: 余弦0.82对应Fit 82；热度兜底结果fit_score为空。
V2 uses this same gate or input rule and applies the separately configured portfolio objective.

ALG-05.definition: Same-account reuse and optional global topic capacity are hard constraints for both ordinary matches and fallback choices. V2 allocates eligible ordinary candidates by the portfolio objective; the legacy reuse-penalty parameters are retained for schema compatibility and must be zero.
acceptance_examples: A topic cannot exceed the configured same-account reuse or global capacity, including when selected as fallback.
V2 uses portfolio utility for allocation and does not apply reuse or official-use penalties.

ALG-06.definition: 每个账号按冻结配置中的生命周期流量比例计算流量槽位数，使用四舍五入；流量/转化角色在该账号日期序列中均匀铺开。槽位业务失败时不伪造经营作用。 V2 reuses this frozen input and candidate contract; portfolio weights and MMR settings are in document.portfolio.
acceptance_examples: 2个槽位、流量50%得到1个流量和1个转化；失败槽位content_role为空。
V2 uses this same gate or input rule and applies the separately configured portfolio objective.

ALG-07.definition: History references observed within the configured frozen window are hard-excluded. Official usage counts are retained in the frozen audit input but do not rank V2 normal candidates.
acceptance_examples: A topic explicitly observed in the account history snapshot is excluded.
Official use counts do not alter V2 normal candidate Fit or portfolio allocation.

ALG-08.definition: 正常候选耗尽后进入普通选题兜底池；兜底继续满足城市与已观察历史去重，按已知热度降序、topic_id升序稳定排序；热度未知排在已知之后。 V2 reuses this frozen input and candidate contract; portfolio weights and MMR settings are in document.portfolio.
acceptance_examples: 账号没有正常候选时选择合法且热度最高的兜底；无合法兜底时槽位失败。
V2 uses this same gate or input rule and applies the separately configured portfolio objective.

ALG-09.definition: 没有正常候选时先尝试合法兜底，再将无兜底槽位记为业务失败；策略/冻结输入不符合执行器契约时回写invalid_response，执行器内部异常回写execution_failed。 V2 reuses this frozen input and candidate contract; portfolio weights and MMR settings are in document.portfolio.
acceptance_examples: 单个槽位无任何合法选题时输出failed而不是让整个任务崩溃；系统异常由任务失败重试机制处理。
V2 uses this same gate or input rule and applies the separately configured portfolio objective.
